name: Tianjiang No. 1
summary:

description.en:
Tianjiang No. 1, designated AR-H2, is Atomrobot's wheeled humanoid manipulation platform. It combines two seven-axis, force-controlled arms with a lifting body and mobile chassis. The vertical adjustment allows the arms to work at different heights, while rotation in place helps the robot reposition between workstations.

Its perception system combines laser-based mapping with vision and proximity sensing for navigation and interaction with its surroundings. The manufacturer describes interchangeable two-finger grippers and five-finger hands, allowing different tooling for different objects. This configuration is intended for mobile handling tasks that require reaching, grasping and moving between work areas rather than remaining fixed beside a single machine.
